name: Tuner garage (experimental)
author: OpenTDU2
description: Adds a tuner garage to the game: a map spot on every island where the tuner-style cars (GT-R, 370Z, 350Z, Impreza WRX STI, RX-8, Delta Integrale, Escort RS Cosworth) get visual parts the vanilla game never had. Parts: seven spoilers and eight exhaust tip sets, each with a choice of finish (chrome, burnt titanium, gold... for the tips; painted to your body colour, gloss and coloured paints, carbon fibre for the spoilers), shown live on your car in a card-style garage menu and saved per car, plus exhaust pops, burble and coloured pop flames on throttle lift-off and gear shifts. Leave it off for the vanilla experience: no garage, no parts - and parts you already bought stay saved, untouched, until you turn the mod back on.
